notes: All 219 listed pieces appear once: 167 singles (b1-b167), plus repeats: log x2 (12 pieces each), sidebox x2 (5 each), arch x6, wheel x6 (wheel+tyre).
Minifigure bodies, heads, hats, headphones and legs are not in the parts list, so they are not nodes.

The five groups the checker found were the truck, the chainsaw, the shovel and the two pine trees. The booklet builds one model, so they are now linked to the truck with contact edges. The chainsaw (b160) rests on the rear plate b33, the shovel (b165) rests on the cab floor b50, and the loose trees (b166, b167) are placed on the load bed b107. These contact positions are assumptions, because the minifigures that hold these items are not parts.

The pictures are small and often unclear, so exact studs are not identified. Most joins use null ports and name only the two pieces that touch. Some attachments (rear sub-assembly, front bumper unit, cab roof pieces, stake clip plates, arches onto green plates) are best-guess placements from the pictures.
The 98284 log clip piece has no stud ports in the catalogue, so the brick above it (log r6) is linked by a contact edge. The axle is modelled as running through all ten bricks and the clip piece.
Wheel arches sit on the green 1x2 plates over the wheel holders, and wheels push onto the wheel-holder axle-holes (revolute).
Stickers (b84) are modelled as adhesive joins to the tiles and panels that carry them.
The 60897 black clip plates are split between the cab (4) and the grabber (4). The 12825 clip tiles are the two on the roof-rack wedge.
The crane base b126 is shown over the rear tan axle (b27) and round tile (b45). The grabber attaches to the boom through b151 (ball) and b139 (socket).
Logs resting on the finished truck are shown as contact edges to the green 4x6 plate (b107). The chain edges between stake cylinders are approximate.
